files.README.md:
# Cilgwyn Slate Yard - splitting runs, August 2026

One row per splitting run; slate_count is the number of slates trimmed on that run. The office writes one export for both yards, Penrhyddn and Trefriw.

turns.prompt: Cilgwyn Slate Yard reports the work of each yard to the quarry office. How many splitting runs did the Penrhyddn yard carry out in August 2026? Give the count as a number alone. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
